001package org.clafer.ast;
002
003import org.clafer.common.Check;
004
005/**
006 *
007 * @author jimmy
008 */
009public record AstSetTest(AstSetExpr left, Op op, AstSetExpr right) implements AstBoolExpr {
010
011    public AstSetTest {
012        left = Check.notNull(left);
013        op = Check.notNull(op);
014        right = Check.notNull(right);
015    }
016
017    @Override
018    public String toString() {
019        return left + " " + op.getSyntax() + " " + right;
020    }
021
022    public static enum Op {
023
024        Equal("="),
025        NotEqual("!=");
026        private final String syntax;
027
028        private Op(String syntax) {
029            this.syntax = syntax;
030        }
031
032        public Op negate() {
033            switch (this) {
034                case Equal:
035                    return NotEqual;
036                case NotEqual:
037                    return Equal;
038                default:
039                    throw new IllegalStateException();
040            }
041        }
042
043        public String getSyntax() {
044            return syntax;
045        }
046    }
047}
